Codex review: blocked before merge. ## What this changes This PR preserves reachable yielded sessions across Gateway restarts and records failures when their continuation source disappears. **Example:** A dashboard session yields while its child executes, then the Gateway restarts and stops that child. - **Before:** The dashboard root can lose its restart marker and be treated as an orphan. - **After:** The original yielded run receives a visible, run-correlated failure without another root model call. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Useful owner-aligned repair, with a verified consumer-test failure, incomplete failure presentation, and an unresolved upgrade gate. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 2 actionable review findings remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Yielded conversations can be orphaned after restart or remain active indefinitely after a failed child-completion handoff. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction repairs an existing session lifecycle contract without adding configuration or replaying stopped executions. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 3 items remain** Keep this PR open: it addresses a source-confirmed restart recovery gap, but an existing restart test contradicts the new behavior and failed-handoff notices need actionable copy. **Priority:** P1 **Reviewed head:** `b6376657406aa24308d9a6dc668eb2bda6e171f6` ## Before merge - [ ] **Update the existing restart E2E for unreachable yielded parents (P2)** - The existing gateway-restart-resume E2E yields its parent while leaving its child executing, then still expects RESUMED_0_parent after shutdown. The new unreachable branch intentionally records a failure instead of admitting that model turn. Exact-head checks-node-changed now fails on this expectation. Update this consumer scenario to assert the run-correlated failure and absence of an extra parent model call, while retaining resume assertions for genuinely interrupted executions. - [ ] **Provide an actionable notice for failed completion handoffs (P2)** - A permanently undelivered yielded batch now terminalizes its requester with only data.error. For an unclassified error, including the new fallback text, recordGatewaySessionRunFailure renders only "Your request couldn't be completed." The user loses the child-handoff explanation and has no recovery instruction. Supply a safe errorNotice explaining that saved child work remains available and asking the user to inspect it before sending a new message, as the restart-failure branch already does. - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - The review found that existing stored data may not work after upgrade. Show that existing data still loads and works with this change. ## Findings - [P2] Update the existing restart E2E for unreachable yielded parents — `test/gateway-restart-resume.e2e.test.ts:1249-1252` - [P2] Provide an actionable notice for failed completion handoffs — `src/agents/subagents/registry/subagent-registry-requester-wake-mutation.ts:238-241` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Supply latest-stable upgrade evidence with retained settings, transcripts, and pre-existing yield batches; surviving dashboard-root continuation is currently covered only at the restart owner.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The subagent registry records yield dependencies and completion handoffs; Gateway shutdown and startup consume those facts to preserve waits or settle their exact session lifecycle. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Session yields] --> B[Registry records dependency] B --> C[Shutdown records restart marker] C --> D[Startup checks wake source] D --> E[Retain reachable wait] D --> F[Record unreachable failure] E --> G[Ordinary child completion handoff] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the existing registry and lifecycle owners, update the affected restart consumer test, and give failed handoffs a clear recovery instruction. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Main's shutdown discovery omits fully drained yielded roots; the PR describes a matching actual-Gateway baseline failure, although no reproduction was run during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The fix uses the right existing owners and removes the relocated settlement implementation; simplification review found no unnecessary parallel recovery mechanism. Full review comments: - [P2] Update the existing restart E2E for unreachable yielded parents — `test/gateway-restart-resume.e2e.test.ts:1249-1252` The existing gateway-restart-resume E2E yields its parent while leaving its child executing, then still expects RESUMED_0_parent after shutdown. The new unreachable branch intentionally records a failure instead of admitting that model turn. Exact-head checks-node-changed now fails on this expectation. Update this consumer scenario to assert the run-correlated failure and absence of an extra parent model call, while retaining resume assertions for genuinely interrupted executions. Confidence: 0.99 - [P2] Provide an actionable notice for failed completion handoffs — `src/agents/subagents/registry/subagent-registry-requester-wake-mutation.ts:238-241` A permanently undelivered yielded batch now terminalizes its requester with only data.error. For an unclassified error, including the new fallback text, recordGatewaySessionRunFailure renders only "Your request couldn't be completed." The user loses the child-handoff explanation and has no recovery instruction. Supply a safe errorNotice explaining that saved child work remains available and asking the user to inspect it before sending a new message, as the restart-failure branch already does. Confidence: 0.97 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.95 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [1bc50e0517ad](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1bc50e0517adf5c4cb8bd025802d55208e9c6318). ### Provenance checked - `Recorded yield waits` keeps the original intent (9464adbe62538155914abe4eef3d6958d5cea5af: Preserve live message waits across restart without restoring old execution or delivery authority.) - `Yielded root restart policy` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (9344233e7a66fe36479d55b7f7ae8e10eb886586: Replace execution reconstruction with one ordinary root resume input after shutdown.) - `Requester settlement receipts` keeps the original intent (6671f14afee7216e0d3dafefa8a56b8a0b2c714c: Reconcile committed outcomes after ownership turnover without replaying delivery or consuming newer work.) - `Unreachable yielded settlement` keeps the original intent (e02ae3ecb66fd7333160bd7dd89d6072b1860f38: Settle unreachable yielded runs through the completion owner while preserving outcomes, timestamps, and cancellation ownership.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - pnpm test:e2e:gateway test/gateway-restart-resume.e2e.test.ts test/gateway-yield-restart.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - pnpm test src/agents/subagents/registry/subagent-registry.requester-wake.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - git diff --check - Verify latest-stable upgrade with existing yield batches, settings, and transcripts intact.
